findings.description: `register_children` maps every `sqlx::Error` to `JobNotFound` with a catch-all `Err(_)` arm, so a dropped connection is reported to the client as a missing job.
findings.suggestion: Match `sqlx::Error::RowNotFound` only and propagate every other error with `?`.

findings.description: The `# Errors` section of `submit_job` lists five variants the function never returns directly and omits the forwarded `submit_job` call.
findings.suggestion: Replace the variant bullets with "* Forwards [`JobClient::submit_job`]'s return values on failure."

findings.description: The PR title has no scope and doesn't end with a period.
findings.suggestion: Use `feat(spider-execution-manager): Forward child-job submissions to the storage service.`
